success_condition: This test checks call shape, not the place chosen. Look at the agent's SPOKEN message that comes immediately before any show_places or open_place tool call (if there is no tool call, look at her only message). PASS if that spoken message ends with a short question that hands the turn back to the caller — e.g. «أحطهم لك على الخريطة؟», «أفتح لك صفحته؟», «تبي شي ثاني؟», «شرايك؟». FAIL if that message ends on a statement (its last sentence has no question mark) — in particular if it ends on a best-time sentence such as «أحلى وقت له بعد العصر.» — and the turn then goes to a tool call or simply stops. A question that appears earlier in the message but is followed by a closing statement also FAILS: the LAST thing she says before the tool call must be the question.

شارع حمد المبارك، قهوة بعد الدوام وهدوء أكثر من الشوارع اللي جنبه. تبي شي على البحر بداله؟
